name: Aiman Zulkifli
bio:
Aiman's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood, watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Malaya, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. Eager to apply his theoretical knowledge, Aiman sought opportunities in local racing teams, initially volunteering as a data analyst and gradually taking on more responsibilities.

As a technical director, Aiman believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing telemetry and performance metrics to identify areas for improvement. He emphasizes clear communication and collaboration within the team, ensuring everyone is aligned with the technical objectives. While still developing his leadership skills, Aiman's pragmatic mindset and dedication to continuous learning make him a valuable asset to any racing organization.

His methodical nature and quiet intensity distinguish him from his peers. Though young, he isn't afraid to challenge established norms with well-researched alternatives. Aiman is also known for his ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and translate them into actionable strategies.

physical.description: Aiman is of average height with a lean build and always appears focused.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Prefers to work late at night when the garage is quiet.
